> `const` **MIGRATED\_ACTIONS**: readonly \[`"StyleProcessingAction"`, `"JavaScriptMinifyAction"`, `"SvgPackagerAction"`, `"SvgReaderAction"`, `"SvgSpriteAction"`, `"SvgToPngAction"`, `"LintAction"`, `"TemplateRenderAction"`\]
